description: End-to-end analytics and reporting workflow for telecom tariff and billing performance, including metric definition, dataset configuration, query execution, anomaly detection, and report scheduling.

tariff_id.description: Unique identifier of a tariff/plan in the billing system

customer_segment_id.description: Identifier for a customer segment (e.g., youth, enterprise, prepaid-high-ARPU)

metric_id.description: Identifier for an analytics metric definition

dataset_id.description: Identifier for an analytics dataset configuration

query_id.description: Identifier for an analytics query execution

report_id.description: Identifier for a saved report configuration

schedule_id.description: Identifier for a report delivery schedule

anomaly_detection_job_id.description: Identifier for an anomaly detection job execution

user_context.description: Information about the user or system initiating the analytics operation

role.description: Role of the user in the system

time_zone.description: IANA time zone identifier, used for date/time handling

locale.description: Locale code for formatting, e.g. en-US

time_range.description: Common time range object used across analytics functions

from.description: Start of the time range (inclusive, ISO 8601)

to.description: End of the time range (exclusive, ISO 8601)

dimension_filter.description: Generic filter object used to restrict analytics queries

dimension.description: Name of the dimension to filter by (e.g., tariff_id, region, channel)

values.description: Values to use with the operator

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: define_tariff_metric
functions.description: Create or update a metric definition for tariff analytics, such as ARPU, churn rate, or discount uptake.

metric_id.description: Existing metric_id to update; omit to create a new metric.

name.description: Human-readable metric name, e.g. 'Monthly ARPU by Tariff'

technical_name.description: System identifier for the metric, used in queries; snake_case.

description.description: Detailed description of what the metric represents.

aggregation.description: How the metric should be aggregated.

field.description: Underlying fact field name in the billing data warehouse.

numerator.description: Field used as numerator for ratio metrics; required if function=ratio.

denominator.description: Field used as denominator for ratio metrics; required if function=ratio.

percentile.description: Percentile value (e.g. 95 for p95) for percentile metrics.

dimensions.description: Dimensions along which this metric is typically broken down (e.g., tariff_id, region).

filters.description: Optional default filters applied whenever this metric is queried.

rollup_granularities.description: Supported time granularities for the metric.

contact_email.description: Primary contact for questions about this metric.

data_steward.description: Name or ID of data steward responsible for the metric.

functions.returns: Metric definition including assigned metric_id and validation status.

functions.name: configure_tariff_dataset
functions.description: Create or update a reusable dataset configuration for tariff analytics, specifying sources, joins, and accessible metrics.

dataset_id.description: Existing dataset_id to update; omit to create a new dataset.

name.description: Human-readable name of the dataset configuration.

description.description: Detailed description of the dataset purpose and coverage.

primary_fact_table.description: Name of the primary fact table, e.g. 'billing_events' or 'cdr_usage_agg'.

data_sources.description: Additional source tables to join for analytics.

table.description: Table name or logical source identifier.

alias.description: Short alias used in join expressions.

available_metrics.description: List of metric_ids that can be queried against this dataset.

row_filters.description: Row-level restrictions based on user role or segment.

applies_to_role.description: Role this filter applies to, e.g. 'billing_ops'.

column_masks.description: Mask or hide specific fields for certain roles.

refresh_policy.description: Controls how often and how the dataset is refreshed from source systems.

schedule_cron.description: Cron expression for scheduled refreshes; required if type=scheduled.

max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum allowed data freshness lag in minutes.

functions.returns: Dataset configuration including dataset_id, validation results, and effective security policies.

functions.name: list_tariff_metrics
functions.description: Search and list available tariff-related metrics with filtering and pagination.

text.description: Free-text search across name and description.

categories.description: Limit results to specific metric categories.

tags.description: Return metrics containing all of these tags.

functions.returns: Paginated list of metrics including metric_id, basic details, and access eligibility for the requesting user.

functions.name: create_tariff_performance_query
functions.description: Define an analytics query for tariff performance, including selected metrics, dimensions, filters, and time range.

dataset_id.description: Dataset on which the query will run.

dimensions.description: Dimensions to group by (e.g., tariff_id, customer_segment_id, region, channel).

dimension_filters.description: Dimension-level filters to apply to the query.

include_archived.description: Whether to include archived or retired tariffs.

customer_segments.description: Optional list of customer_segment_ids to scope the query.

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows; used for safety.

field.description: Metric or dimension field to order by.

functions.returns: Analytics query definition including a generated query_id and a pre-execution validation report.

functions.name: execute_tariff_query
functions.description: Execute a previously defined tariff analytics query, with support for asynchronous execution and sampling.

query_id.description: Identifier of the query to execute.

priority.description: Priority level for the query execution.

sampling.description: Optional sampling settings for large datasets.

max_runtime_seconds.description: Maximum allowed runtime before automatic cancellation.

functions.returns: Query execution handle including query_id, execution status, and either partial or complete result metadata.

functions.name: get_query_status_and_results
functions.description: Retrieve the current status and, if available, the results of a previously executed tariff analytics query.

include_data.description: Whether to include actual result data in the response.

pagination.description: Pagination settings when retrieving data for large result sets.

page_token.description: Token from a previous page of results.

functions.returns: Query execution status, runtime statistics, and optionally a page of result data with pagination tokens.

functions.name: detect_tariff_anomalies
functions.description: Run anomaly detection on tariff metrics over a specified time range to identify unusual behavior such as sudden ARPU drops or spike in discounts.

dataset_id.description: Dataset on which anomalies will be detected.

metrics.description: List of metric_ids to monitor for anomalies.

analysis_granularity.description: Time granularity at which anomalies are detected.

scope.description: Dimensions across which to detect anomalies.

tariff_ids.description: Tariff IDs to monitor; if empty, all eligible tariffs are included.

method.description: Anomaly detection method or algorithm family.

min_severity_score.description: Minimum severity score for an anomaly to be reported.

min_absolute_change.description: Minimum absolute change (in metric units) to be considered anomalous.

min_relative_change_pct.description: Minimum relative change (percentage) to be considered anomalous.

functions.returns: Anomaly detection job metadata including anomaly_detection_job_id, status, and if sync, the list of detected anomalies.

functions.name: get_anomaly_detection_job
functions.description: Retrieve the status and results of a previously started anomaly detection job for tariff metrics.

anomaly_detection_job_id.description: Identifier of the anomaly detection job.

include_results.description: Whether to include detected anomalies in the response.

filters.description: Optional filters to narrow down reported anomalies.

functions.returns: Anomaly detection job status, configuration details, and optionally a filtered list of detected anomalies.

functions.name: generate_tariff_performance_report
functions.description: Generate a consumable report (PDF, dashboard snapshot, CSV bundle) based on a query or anomaly detection job.

report_id.description: Existing report_id to regenerate or customize; omit to create a new report definition.

source.description: Primary data source for the report.

description.description: Summary of what the report covers.

layout.description: Visual and structural layout configuration for the report.

widgets.description: Visual widgets such as tables and charts.

source_field.description: Metric or dimension field used in the widget.

distribution.description: How and to whom the report should be delivered.

value.description: User ID, email address, or group identifier.

functions.returns: Generated report metadata including report_id, file location or dashboard URL, and generation status.

functions.name: schedule_tariff_report
functions.description: Create or update a schedule for recurring tariff performance reports with delivery channels and recipients.

schedule_id.description: Existing schedule_id to update; omit to create a new schedule.

name.description: Friendly name for the schedule, e.g. 'Weekly ARPU by Tariff'.

frequency.description: How often the report should run.

cron_expression.description: Optional precise cron expression overriding frequency.

time_window.description: Default time range to use for each run, relative to execution time.

anchor_time_zone.description: Time zone for interpreting lookback windows.

distribution.description: Distribution settings overriding or extending the report defaults.

failover_policy.description: Behavior in case of repeated report generation failures.

functions.returns: Report schedule details including schedule_id, next run time, and effective distribution settings.

functions.name: list_tariff_report_schedules
functions.description: List and filter existing tariff report schedules for monitoring and governance.

report_id.description: Filter schedules tied to a particular report.

functions.returns: Paginated list of report schedules with basic metadata, last run status, and next scheduled run.

functions.name: retry_or_cancel_analytics_job
functions.description: Retry a failed query or anomaly detection job, or cancel a running one for error recovery and control.

job_type.description: Type of analytics job to act upon.

job_id.description: Identifier of the job (query_id or anomaly_detection_job_id).

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the manual retry.

cancel_reason.description: Reason for job cancellation when action='cancel'.

functions.returns: Job control result indicating new job status, retry job handle if applicable, and any error details.

functions.name: audit_tariff_analytics_access
functions.description: Retrieve an audit log of access to sensitive tariff analytics, including who ran which queries or viewed which reports.

tariff_ids.description: Tariff IDs whose analytics access should be audited.

functions.returns: Paginated list of audit events including who accessed which tariff analytics artifacts, when, and from which channel.

functions.name: compare_tariff_performance_scenarios
functions.description: Run comparative analytics between multiple tariffs or tariff change scenarios (e.g., before/after price change) and summarize key differences.

label.description: Human-readable name of the base scenario.

comparison_scenarios.description: One or more scenarios to compare with the base.

metrics.description: Metric IDs to compare across scenarios.

normalize_by.description: Optional normalization factor for fair comparison.

functions.returns: Scenario comparison results including per-metric deltas, significance indications, and optional detailed tables per scenario.

functions.name: search_tariff_analytics_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across tariff_analytics entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching tariff_analytics entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_tariff_analytics_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N tariff_analytics records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_tariff_analytics_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many tariff_analytics records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_tariff_analytics_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many tariff_analytics records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_tariff_analytics_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of tariff_analytics data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_tariff_analytics_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a tariff_analytics dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_tariff_analytics_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more tariff_analytics entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_tariff_analytics_snapshot
functions.description: Restore tariff_analytics state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_tariff_analytics_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the tariff_analytics workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_tariff_analytics_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across tariff_analytics metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_tariff_analytics_audit_events
functions.description: Search the tariff_analytics audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_tariff_analytics_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers tariff_analytics workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_tariff_analytics_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for tariff_analytics events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_tariff_analytics_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for tariff_analytics events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_tariff_analytics_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off tariff_analytics job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_tariff_analytics_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled tariff_analytics jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_tariff_analytics_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled tariff_analytics job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_tariff_analytics_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a tariff_analytics operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_tariff_analytics_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a tariff_analytics action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_tariff_analytics_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a tariff_analytics approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_tariff_analytics_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any tariff_analytics entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_tariff_analytics_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a tariff_analytics entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_tariff_analytics_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling tariff_analytics behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_tariff_analytics_policies
functions.description: List tariff_analytics policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_tariff_analytics_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two tariff_analytics-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_tariff_analytics_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a tariff_analytics entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.
